company.name: Innoshop.co
company.shortDescription: Innoshop develops an e-commerce enablement platform designed to help retailers in MENA to sell online.
company.description: Innoshop.co is a creator of an e-commerce platform that enables online sales for retailers in the MENA region. Their business provides a website and an integrated mobile app to support and promote small- and medium-sized initiatives, particularly e-commerce projects and e-stores, and to promote and encourage e-commerce in the Arab world. Customers are provided with technical solutions in an easy-to-use and cost-effective manner that meets their needs.
